translation.description: Run code under named locale categories.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Mapping of category names to locale names.

translation.details: LC_ALL is refused. Other categories are passed to the process locale. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

import datetime
return with_locale(
    {"LC_TIME": "es_ES.UTF-8"},
    lambda: [datetime.date(2000, month, 1).strftime("%B") for month in (1, 2, 3)],
)
